kind_definitions.blanket_ai: Additional insured status granted automatically to any party for whom the insured has a written contract requiring it - no separate endorsement/schedule needed per certificate holder.
kind_definitions.scheduled_ai: Additional insured status granted only to specifically named/scheduled parties.
kind_definitions.waiver_subrog: Waiver of subrogation (blanket = automatic by written contract, not scheduled).
kind_definitions.primary_noncontrib: Primary and non-contributory wording - insured's policy pays first, does not seek contribution from certificate holder's own insurance.
kind_definitions.notice_of_cancellation: Cancellation notice provision/endorsement (ACORD 25 standard language vs. a carrier-specific notice-of-cancellation endorsement).
kind_definitions.other: Any other endorsement type found (e.g. designated-insured, named-insured, contractors extension) that doesn't fit the above.

confidence_scale.high: Endorsement form read directly (carrier dec/endorsement schedule/standalone endorsement PDF) - form number and wording confirmed.
confidence_scale.medium: COI/template description-of-operations wording only, or reconciliation notes it as 'medium' (e.g. dec unreadable, single corroborating doc).
confidence_scale.low: Conflicting sources, unread/scanned carrier doc, or in-force status uncertain - do not rely on without Alex's confirmation.
